notes.title: Spearhead Games' 7th Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31655037/a72c3e56bdc5a212d7fcc8928a09f9115bc933b7.jpg[/img]

It feels amazing to say, but we’re celebrating seven years of being a studio, which is an accomplishment we’re all so proud of. We founded Spearhead with high hopes for being successful enough to keep making the kind of games we were passionate about, and to be able to make them how we wanted to. Now that we’re looking back over the last seven years of doing just that, it means so much that we get to continue working at those goals.

As of right now, we’re working hard on Project Witchstone, our newest title. An RPG with a storyline generated in reaction to player choice in a reactive, vibrant world where factions vie for control of an isolated continent and the mysterious magic of the Witchstones. It would mean a lot if you’d go give Witchstone a look and consider adding it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1064120/Project_Witchstone/

[h1]Anniversary Sale: October 16 to 23[/h1]
We’ll be running a sale on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/439190/Stories_The_Path_of_Destinies/]Stories: The Path of Destinies[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/455820/Omensight_Definitive_Edition/]Omensight[/url] as part of the seven years of Spearhead anniversary celebration, so make sure to pick up a copy before October 23rd if you want to get a deal.

From everyone here at Spearhead, thank you for all of your support over the years, and we’re excited to keep pushing to do new and exciting things to repay it.

notes.title: Stories has joined some very exciting Time Travel games
notes.content:
Hello Time Travelers,

Journey through different time periods, bizarre worlds and even space!

Greetings, curious adventurers and daring pioneers! The doors have opened to times long gone and strange worlds long forgotten. Or would you rather see into the future and find out what awaits humanity? That is also part of this journey. 

Seven amazing experiences are waiting for you in the [b]Time Travel bundle[/b]. 

Take a look:
[list]
[*] [b]Stories: The Path of Destinies[/b]
[*] [b]Omensight[/b]
[*] Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest
[*] The Inner World
[*] Chronology
[*] Pankapu
[*] Tick Tock Isle[/list]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yX1Hd_mt6Qw&feature=youtu.be 

Games from different genres and styles have been gathered together, yet united by the theme of time travel to remind you how diverse the experience can be. 

You will rely on intelligence and cunning to solve challenging riddles. Other times, combining skill and blunt force is the only way to protect what is dear to you. And when that doesn’t work, going back through a time loop over and over again may shine light on the right path. 

Conquer time and space in a whirlpool of worlds so unlike each other!

With all the love from Spearhead Games,

Jonathan from Spearhead Games

notes.title: Stories Patch Notes - 2018-10-05
notes.content:
Hello Dear Friends,

It's been 2 years since the last update and for that we apologize. We were busy making [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/455820/Omensight/]Omensight[/url]...

But during the production of Omensight, we kept thinking about coming back to Stories, not completely satisfied with the game and wanting to address all the major issues that have been flagged by you, our community, since the game's launch in 2016. We jumped on the opportunity once Omensight was done.

So here it is: [b]Update #4[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18955763/b56669cb0c5dd2501c4523ea5e12dd1b0b3c0a0a.png[/img]

The game engine has been updated to Unreal Engine 4.18, improving performances and visuals and that's why we're calling this version Stories: The Path of Destinies Remastered.

Also the following issues have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Global: Sometimes players can't unlock "Boreas discoverer" achievement
[*] Global: Hooking a Shield Raven can increase the Combo meter to a high number
[*] Global: If players switch sword right before a locked door, they won't be able to open it
[*] Global: In wide resolutions, player can't click on Back or Apply in Options menu
[*] Global: It was possible to fall by dashing in corners
[*] Global: Perfect Strike text sometimes overlaped with Combo Meter
[*] Global: Portrait stay on and dialogues can be missed when using Alt-Tab during dialogues
[*] Global: Quitting in tutorial after crafting sword and loading back in did not leave the sword equipped
[*] Global: Ravens can sometimes miss their combat Idle animation
[*] Global: Subtitles for scripted dialogues could disappear if a banter had started playing just before
[*] Global: Using the Grappling Hook on an enemy started a combo
[*] Menus: Advanced Graphics Options have been made easier to access
[*] Menus: Continue highlight color was different than the others
[*] Menus: Option items sometimes weren't saved (without closing the game)
[*] Desert: Elevator does not open door when stopped
[*] Fleet: Players can fall off the map by dashing back to the platform
[*] Fleet: Combat slowmo sometimes continues during following cutscene
[*] Fleet: Hero Path - Zenobia can appear in T-Pose inside a ship during the Farfarer cutscene
[*] Fleet: Player can be stuck, unable to reach an hookpost on secondary path
[*] Forest: Raven can be stuck on a rock ("kicked enemies getting stuck on higher level terrain")
[*] Mountains: Some subtitles could be played during the wrong cutscene
[*] Nexus: Player was able to leave combat area by kicking an enemy and following up with an attack
[*] Nexus: Sometimes characters were invisible after skipping the intro cutscene
[*] Nexus: Issues with Russian localization after completing the level
[*] Nexus: The player can walk off the airship in Nexus by repeatedly attacking the back side
[*] Prison: Eyeballs' cone of vision could go through some walls
[*] Prison: Sublevel missing when coming from the first pink door
[*] Ruins: Quitting game during the end sequence (or even earlier?) and continuing game makes the wrong sequence play
[*] Tutorial: Altar kept its "new" green VFX after player got their first upgrade
[*] Tutorial: The mouse icon can be seen on the Counter tutorial pop-up
[*] Village: Controls could be lost after countering an attack
[/list]

Thanks so much for the support! Take care!

notes.title: Omensight Is Available Today!
notes.content:
After 18 months of intense production, Omensight is finally here!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/455820/Omensight/

To mark the event, the game is 10% off until May 22. Also, we’ve released a sweet new trailer:

https://youtu.be/q25Is2zYVHc

We hope you’ll enjoy your time in Urralia. This world is now *your* playground to discover (and re-discover) and defeat enemies in creative ways with the powers of the Harbinger. Share with everyone all the cool moves you manage to pull off!

Also, we’ve placed some nods to our previous game, Stories: The Path of Destinies. So be on the lookout for those :)

And finally, please check out our official wiki and feel free to contribute: https://omensight.gamepedia.com/Omensight_Wiki

Thanks for playing Omensight!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31655037/d4b2aea3780eb33ab84b55a68356a28ceea53338.jpg[/img]

- Phil from Spearhead Games (SHG_Phil on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/spearheadgames]Discord[/url])

notes.title: Free Weekend in Anticipation for the Launch of Omensight!
notes.content:
[b]From May 11th to 13th[/b], [i]Stories: The Path of Destinies[/i] is yours to keep forever when you add it to your Steam library.

As a favor, we ask that you check out our upcoming game and spiritual sequel to Stories, the action-adventure murder mystery game [b]Omensight[/b]. The game launches on May 15th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/455820/Omensight/

[h1]Important: How to easily support us![/h1]

We've been running a contest for the last week called [url=https://www.omensight.com/wishlist-quest/][b]Wishlist Quest[/b][/url]. This weekend promotion is actually our way of thanking the 40,000 people who've participated so far and were waiting for their rewards. But we haven't reached all our goals yet!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18955763/8655137b364b681e036de0b6240e79e25f90b0ed.png[/img]

Just by signing up, you will be receiving a [b]Collector's Edition[/b] of Stories, which adds the art book and the soundtrack, the upcoming Omensight digital art book, and any future unlocked rewards!

Also, you also get the chance to win one of 100 free Steam keys for Omensight!

The contest ends on May 15 so please help us gain visibility for Omensight out by participating and talking about [url=https://www.omensight.com/wishlist-quest/]Wishlist Quest![/url]

Come say hi on [url=http://discord.gg/spearheadgames]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/spearheadmtl]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/spearheadmtl]Facebook[/url]!

Cheers!
Phil from Spearhead Games

notes.title: Stories Patch Notes - 2016-06-02
notes.content:
Hello dear Stories' Community!

You have been waiting for it, and we thank you for all the kind words and great support we have received while we were preparing this patch and its associated new features!


[b]Stories' patch #3[/b] contains the following features and hotfixes:
[list][*]Advanced graphic settings
[list][*]Shadow Quality (Very Low / Low / Medium / High)
[*]Texture Detail (Very Low / Low / Medium / High)
[*]Shader Detail (Very Low / Low / Medium / High)
[*]Effect Detail (Very Low / Low / Medium / High)
[*]Render Scale (65% / 75% / 100%)
[*]FXAA Anti-Aliasing (Activate / Deactivate)[/list]
[*]Activate/Deactivate Vibration
[*]Activate/Deactivate Hero Path rewards (in Gameplay setting)
[*]Show/Hide Truth Finder icon (in Gameplay setting)
[*]Fixed Menu Pause
[*]Fixed Mana fruits spawned after True Path
[*]Fixed Game properly saves on Winning Path
[*]Fixed Game properly saves when not on Winning Path
[*]Fixed Xbox controller icons
[*]Fixed sound bugs
[*]Fixed Desert Temple elevator
[*]Fixed controller issue
[*]Fixed Magic Sword
[*] Improved quality graphics
[*]Fixed "Paleontologist", "Boreas discoverer" and "Is it a sword? Is it a key"? achievements
[*]Removed "Gray fox is my pup" achievement[/list]
 

We are also very excited to announce two DLCs which have been requested since the very beginning by the community:
[list][*][b][URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/471741]Stories: The Path Of Destinies Artbook[/URL][/b]
[*][b][URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/471740]Stories: The Path Of Destinies Original Soundtrack[/URL][/b]
[/list]


We hope that you'll enjoy all this cool stuff and continue to share the game with your friends. :)

notes.title: Stories Patch Notes - 2016-04-19
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are back with another update!

Thanks for your reports and your patience. We are working as fast as possible to make your playing experience as good as possible.

Here is what is included in the patch:
[list][*]Added "Very Low" graphics setting option
[*]Added option to use "Desktop" resolution
[*]Added additional resolution options for:
[list][*]2560x1440 (WQHD)
[*]2560x1600 (WQXGA)
[*]3840x2160 (4k Ultra HD)[/list]
[*]Fixed not being able to click on final choice
[*]Fixed Mountain secondary path streaming issue
[*]Fixed mouse navigation issues in the Forest and Nexus
[*]Fixed progression blocker when restarting a checkpoint in the Prison
[*]Fixed progression blocker when hitting breakables in the Mountains
[*]Fixed other minor issues[/list]

Another patch is on its way and will be focused on:
[list][*]Performance optimization
[*]More graphic settings
[*]More gameplay options
[*]Toggle options for rewards[/list]

But first, the majority of the team will be heading to PAX East! If you're attending the show, please come by booth #5201 and say hi.

Thanks again for playing Stories: The Path of Destinies and for all your kind words! As always, feel free to post in our Steam forums and talk you to all after PAX East.

notes.title: Stories Patch Notes - 2016-04-16
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, we would like to thank every one of you for the awesome support we received around the game over the past few days!

The quality of your reports allowed us to work quickly and patch some of the most annoying issues some of you may have encountered with the game.

We will continue to fix and release patches in a very close future and continue to improve your experience!

Today's patch will fix the following issues:

[list][*]Fixed Warlock sometimes stop moving
[*]Fixed Warlock sometimes teleporting through walls and getting stuck
[*]Fixed some achievements (the progressive ones) not working properly
[*]Fixed player's choice not saving properly for the Nexus
[*]Adding an additional resolution 1920x1200[/list]

Thanks again for playing Stories: The Path of Destinies and all your kind words!
